description: Read this machine's cross-machine mailbox, the messages another computer's agent left here over a file-synced bus folder, and send messages back the same way. A session-start hook shows new mail automatically; this is the on-demand mid-session re-check. Triggers: "/inbox", "check inbox", "messages from the other machine".
